summary: UTime Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer (ticker FXH0), filed a Form 6-K disclosing equity-for-services arrangements rather than a transaction. On September 8, 2026 the company signed a Special Strategic Advisory Services Agreement with Li Donghong and on September 17, 2026 issued grant agreements delivering 1,000,000 Class A ordinary shares total under its 2026 Equity Incentive Plan — 600,000 to the advisor and 400,000 to business-development provider Keru Jiang, whose April 1, 2026 cash contract was converted to equity on July 1, 2026. No price, stake, board recommendation, or advisor is stated, so no special-situation deal terms exist; the sole arbitrage-relevant watch item is potential shareholder dilution.
